parameters.name: EnableSoundCode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the sound code.

><notice> If you set this parameter to **true**, you must specify the **SoundCodeConfig** parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects).

parameters.name: SoundCodeConfig
parameters.description:
The sound code configuration. This parameter contains the following fields:


- **SoundCodeContent**: the marketing content of the sound code, such as the URL of product details.

- **AdditionalDuration**: the duration for which the sound code is played after the speech corpus playback ends. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15.

parameters.name: SpeechCode
parameters.description: The ID of the speech corpus. You can call [QuerySpeechList](~~217576~~) to query the ID.

parameters.name: SpeechRate
parameters.description: The broadcast speed. Default value: 0. Valid values: -500 to 500.

parameters.name: Voice
parameters.description: The broadcast voice of the speech corpus. You can call [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) to query available voice types. Set this parameter to the **Value** in **VoiceList** of the response.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: The volume. Default value: 50. Valid values: 0 to 100.
